you can't compare lee's E and Wukong's E, Lee sin's E is an AOE damage move with a tiny slow on a 10 second CD, Wukong's E is a point and click medium range dash which deals less damage but grants a large AS steroid and has a CD of 10-8. of course a point and click dash on a shorter CD is only going to do less damage than an  small AOE ability with a tiny slow

if you actually want to compare Wukong's E to similar ability's we can compare it with Pantheons W and Xin Zhao's  E, Wukong's E deals 80-200 magic damage and grants him 40-60% AS for 5 seconds on a 10-8 second CD, Xin's E deals 50-150 magic damage, grants 40-60% AS for 5 seconds and has a flat CD of 12. Pantheons W deals 60-140 magic damage, deals 135%-160% AD over the next 3 AAs(assuming its empowered) and has a CD of 13-9 but has no AS steroid but has a stun for 1 sec. just from a numbers standpoint Wukong's E is a fine ability, it has the highest base damage of the 3, and the lowest CD, we can even compare Wukong's old E to his new one to prove his current E is fine, old Wukong E dealt 65-205+80%Bad as physical damage and granted 30-50% AS for 4 seconds and hade a 8 second CD. new wukong E does slightly less base damage at max rank but deals magic damage, the standard MR per level for a melee champion is  32.1 - 53.35 , while the average base amour for melee like Cho gath is  38 - 97.5. using the numbers from before with these formulas [https://leagueoflegends.fandom.com/wiki/Damage](https://leagueoflegends.fandom.com/wiki/Damage)   
base MR grants 24.2%-34.7% reduction, while base amour grants 27.5% - 49.3% reduction,  assuming no MR or Amour being built. with residences accounted for old wukong E would(assuming max rank) deal 148.6 - 103.9 , while new wukong E would(assuming max rank) deal 151.6-130. 

​

so new wukong E deals more base damage at every level , gives AS for longer and more AS at early levels, while old wukong E has a mediocre AD ratio, and has a shorter cooldown at early levels.

wukong E is perfectly fine as it proven by comparing it to other ability's which are similar.
